title: Otoplasty (ear pinning)
what: The surgeon reshapes the ear cartilage so the ears sit closer to the head. The cut is usually made behind the ear, so the scar is barely visible.
why: When the ears stick out noticeably and this bothers you. In children, it is usually done from age 6 to 7.
duration: surgery usually takes 1 to 2 hours; you often go home the same day or the next day
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners. The doctor will tell you what to stop and when
If you or your relatives had problems with anesthesia
If you tend to get thick scars

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Blood tests and other checks. The clinic will give you a list.

prepare.title: Anesthesia
prepare.text: Children usually have general anesthesia. Adults sometimes have local numbing. The anesthesiologist will talk with you.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Before anesthesia, you usually do not eat or drink for several hours. The clinic will tell you the exact time.

prepare.title: Hair and clothes
prepare.text: Wash your hair the day before. Wear clothes that open at the front, so you do not pull them over your head.

bring: Loose clothes that open at the front
For a child: a favorite toy
steps: On the day of surgery, the surgeon and anesthesiologist see you
In the operating room, you get anesthesia or a numbing injection
The surgeon makes a cut behind the ear
The cartilage is shaped and held with stitches
A soft bandage is put around your head
feel: After surgery, the ears hurt and ache. You will get pain medicine
The ears are swollen and may look uneven. This is temporary
The bandage feels tight, and sleeping can be uncomfortable
after: The bandage is worn for a few days, then usually an elastic headband at night. The surgeon will tell you how long
Do not get the bandage or your head wet until you are allowed
No sports or active games for a few weeks
red_flags: Sudden ear pain that keeps getting worse
The bandage is soaked with blood
The ear is red, very swollen, or has pus

faq.q: At what age can otoplasty be done?
faq.a: Usually from age 6 to 7, when the ear has almost finished growing. The surgeon decides.
The scar is usually behind the ear and becomes hard to see over time.

reminders.text: Ear surgery tomorrow. Get your documents and clothes that open at the front ready. Eat and drink only until the time the clinic gave you.
